name: Experimental Data for Implementation-Aware Real-Time Benchmark of Incremental PI and Mamdani Fuzzy Logic Speed Control for a Brushed DC Motor
description: This dataset contains the experimental data supporting the manuscript entitled Implementation-Aware Real-Time Benchmark of Incremental PI and Mamdani Fuzzy Logic Speed Control for a Brushed DC Motor. The experiments compare an incremental proportional–integral controller and a fixed-rule Mamdani Type-1 fuzzy logic controller implemented on the same Texas Instruments TMS320F2812 DSP platform. Both controllers were evaluated using identical encoder feedback, QEP-based speed estimation, a 1 ms sampling period, PWM actuation, voltage-command limitation, supply conditions, measured channels, and KPI-extraction procedures. The dataset covers nominally no-load step-response experiments at reference speeds of 955 rpm and 6685 rpm. The recorded quantities include reference speed, measured motor speed, voltage-equivalent command monitor, and armature current. The associated performance indicators include 10–90% rise time, percentage overshoot, ±1% settling time, transient peak armature current, and steady-state armature current. The files are organized by controller and operating point. A README file describes the file structure, variable names, units, controller parameters, and the procedure used to reproduce the reported performance indicators and figures.
